modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Items that do not fit the sizing device or exceed the carry-on allowance are treated as checked baggage and charged applicable baggage fees.

carryon_allowance.value: Econo, Member Exclusive, EconoFlex, Premium, PremiumFlex, Business and BusinessFlex guests may bring 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Carry-on bag: 56 cm x 23 cm x 36 cm (22 in. x 9 in. x 14 in.), wheels included; it must go in the overhead bin.

carryon_weight.value: No weight figure is given: the carry-on must be light enough for you to place it in the overhead compartment unaided (assistance is available on request for guests with special needs or a disability).

personal_item.notes: WestJet's carry-on page shows the personal item as 41 cm x 15 cm x 33 cm (16 in. x 6 in. x 13 in.) in its size graphic, but its text says 41 centimeters or 16 inches by 33 centimeters or 13 inches by 14 centimeters or 6 inches.
conflicting_values: 41 cm x 15 cm x 33 cm (16 in. x 6 in. x 13 in.) (size graphic)
41 cm x 33 cm x 14 cm (16 in. x 13 in. x 6 in.) (page text)

ultrabasic.value: UltraBasic guests may bring 1 personal item only and cannot bring or pay for a carry-on bag, except on travel to and from Europe and Asia, or when Extended Comfort has been bought for all flights in one direction. A carry-on brought to the gate otherwise must be checked, with a checked baggage fee and a service fee.

piece_weight_economy.notes: WestJet Economy Class checked baggage allowance.

piece_weight_business.value: 2 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each
piece_weight_business.notes: WestJet Business Class checked baggage allowance.

piece_weight_first.value: 3 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each
piece_weight_first.notes: WestJet First Class checked baggage allowance.

modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: Airport kiosks don't support check-in; they print bag tags and boarding passes only.

online_checkin.value: Check-in opens 24 hours before departure for most flights.

domestic_cutoff.value: Domestic: check-in closes 1 hour (60 minutes) before departure. WestJet recommends arriving 2 hours (120 minutes) before.

international_cutoff.value: U.S. & international: check-in closes 1 hour (60 minutes) before departure, or 1 hour 15 minutes (75 minutes) from Calgary, Edmonton, Toronto and Vancouver. Recommended arrival is 2 hours 30 minutes (150 minutes) before.

bag_drop.value: Bags are accepted up to 3 hours (180 minutes) before departure at most locations, until the check-in cut-off; WestJet recommends dropping them 1 hour 30 minutes (90 minutes) before.

boarding.value: Arrive at the gate 40 minutes before departure; boarding cut-off is 15 minutes before departure.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: Under APPR (Air Passenger Protection Regulations), WestJet provides meals, drinks, WiFi/phone access for 2+ hour delays, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays within carrier control.

rebooking_refund.value: Rebooking on next available WestJet or partner flight, or full refund to original payment method if delayed 3+ hours within carrier control.

compensation.value: APPR statutory compensation (up to $1,000 CAD) for flight delays of 3+ hours within carrier control.

fare_name.value: UltraBasic (includes 1 personal item; no carry-on bag, no checked bag, no seat selection, non-refundable)

seat_selection_included.value: Paid advance seat selection for UltraBasic, Econo, and Member Exclusive; included in EconoFlex, Premium, and Business

change_cancellation_policy.value: UltraBasic fares cannot be changed or cancelled; Econo and Premium fares allow changes for a fee

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Business Class (787 Dreamliner 1-2-1 lie-flat suites), Premium (2-2 or 2-3-2 extra legroom with free dining), Extended Comfort (extra legroom & early boarding), and Economy

reserved_or_random.value: Select a seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare tier, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: WestJet automatically seats children under 14 adjacent to an accompanying adult free of charge before check-in
